headline: CAVA Appoints Amiee Bayer-Thomas to Board of Directors
summary: WASHINGTON, August 03, 2026--CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand that brings heart, health, and humanity to food, today announced the appointment of Amiee Bayer-Thomas, Chief Retail Officer of Ulta Beauty, Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective today, July 29.
